Jordan (sales): Heads-up: Enterprise-Z wants an air-gapped POC. Requirements from their CISO: signed offline bundle, delta patching on a ~6-week cadence, SBOM, offline activation, and maintenance windows capped at 2h. Is this feasible from packaging & pricing POV?

Priya Shah: Quick Q — do they require FIPS/HSM integration? Also need egress-free verification for signatures and SBOM. Any KMS options for offline flows?

Matt Chen: Yes — we have FIPS-capable crypto builds and can support HSM/KMS integration for key management, but offline activation requires pre-provisioned or customer-held keys. We should map options: 1) Redwood-signed bundles + customer trust key, 2) customer-rotateable signing keys (JWS/GPG).

Elaine Rivera: Packaging proposal: deliver a compressed bundle (tar.gz) with manifest.json, checksums.txt, CycloneDX SBOM, and a detached signature (bundle.sig). Deltas produced with rsync-friendly binary diffs to minimize transfer. Verification example: ```gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json``` and ```sha256sum -c checksums.txt```

Jordan (sales): They asked if we can provide signed delta-only artifacts (so they don't need to ship full bundle each patch) — and pricing: do we bill per bundle or per POC reserved cpu/gpu commit?

Matt Chen: We can provide signed deltas between published releases. For pricing, standard POC model: one-time POC license + optional short-term reserved commit if they want SLA. SalesOps can propose a capped-usage POC price.

Priya Shah: Security questionnaire items to answer: SBOM format (they prefer CycloneDX), supply-chain attestations, offline signature verification process, key rotation cadence, and revocation flow. Also they want proof of code signing pipeline (attestation).

Elaine Rivera: We emit CycloneDX JSON by default; SPDX export is available on request. Key rotation: recommend 3-6 months for signing keys; for offline we provide a rotation bundle and signed rotation manifest they can apply during maintenance windows.

Jordan (sales): @Matt @Elaine please draft a short runbook for their SREs: offline verify -> apply delta patch -> smoke test -> rollback steps. They want step-by-step commands.

Matt Chen: Will do. Quick apply snippet for the runbook: ```tar xzf rw_bundle_v1.2.3.tar.gz && gpg --verify bundle.sig && sha256sum -c checksums.txt && ./install.sh --offline --accept-licenses``` Rollback: keep last-good bundle and `./install.sh --rollback --from /opt/rw/bundles/rw_bundle_v1.2.2`
